_generationSettingsNotes.aliensPerAgent: How many aliens each player receives when the host starts the game.
_generationSettingsNotes.minimumEyes: The lowest number of eyes a generated alien can have.
_generationSettingsNotes.maximumEyes: The highest number of eyes a generated alien can have.
_generationSettingsNotes.minimumHeightMetres: The shortest possible height for a generated alien, in metres.
_generationSettingsNotes.maximumHeightMetres: The tallest possible height for a generated alien, in metres.
_generationSettingsNotes.singleRequestMinimumPercent: For single-trait Earth requests, the smallest percentage of all remaining aliens that can become the request quota.
_generationSettingsNotes.singleRequestMaximumPercent: For single-trait Earth requests, the largest percentage of all remaining aliens that can become the request quota.
_generationSettingsNotes.singleRequestMinimumSpaces: For single-trait Earth requests, the smallest quota allowed unless fewer aliens remain in the whole game.
_generationSettingsNotes.singleRequestMaximumSpaces: For single-trait Earth requests, the largest quota allowed even when many aliens remain in the whole game.
_generationSettingsNotes.compoundRequestMinimumPercent: For two-trait Earth requests, the smallest percentage of all remaining aliens that can become the request quota.
_generationSettingsNotes.compoundRequestMaximumPercent: For two-trait Earth requests, the largest percentage of all remaining aliens that can become the request quota.
_generationSettingsNotes.compoundRequestMinimumSpaces: For two-trait Earth requests, the smallest quota allowed unless fewer aliens remain in the whole game.
_generationSettingsNotes.compoundRequestMaximumSpaces: For two-trait Earth requests, the largest quota allowed even when many aliens remain in the whole game.
_generationSettingsNotes.heightRequestThresholds: The height values Earth can use when making requests such as aliens taller than 1.8 metres.
